faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1.a: Ihsan is a fundraising platform for Malaysian NGOs — enabling one-time & recurring donations through Stripe, with a powerful admin dashboard.
faq.q2.q: How much does it cost for NGOs?
faq.q2.a: Completely free during MVP. Only a 2.5% processing fee per transaction. No additional platform fee.
faq.q3.a: Register, fill in your NGO profile, connect Stripe — ready in under 30 minutes. Manual approval required.
faq.q4.a: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, and Google Pay via Stripe. More payment methods coming in future updates.
faq.q5.q: Can donors set up recurring donations?
faq.q5.a: Yes! Donors can choose weekly, monthly, or yearly recurring plans. Auto-billing handled by Stripe with smart retry logic.

case.facts.title: At a glance
case.facts.location: Kg. Pengkalan Maras, Kuala Nerus, Terengganu
case.about.title: About Madrasah Darul Falah
case.about.p1: Madrasah Darul Falah is a religious primary school in Kg. Pengkalan Maras, Mengabang Telipot, Kuala Nerus, Terengganu. Established in 2015 and opened in January 2016 on donated land, the madrasah provides Quranic education and core Islamic studies to 185 students, supported by 16 teachers and 6 support staff.
case.about.p2: Many of its students are orphans and asnaf from difficult family backgrounds who could not otherwise afford schooling, meals, books, or boarding. To keep serving them, the madrasah launched a development fund with a Phase 1 target of RM1.7 million — the main building is now more than 50% complete.
case.challenge.title: The challenge
case.challenge.p1: Like many madrasahs, Darul Falah raised funds through account numbers on posters, WhatsApp appeals, and seasonal campaigns. Donors had to copy account numbers, transfer manually, and send proof of payment — and every official receipt was typed by hand.
case.challenge.p2: Giving spiked during Ramadan, then went quiet for the rest of the year. There was no way for supporters to give monthly, no record of who was donating, and no simple donate button on the madrasah's own website.
case.challenge.quote: Supporters kept telling us they wanted to help beyond Ramadan. We believed them — we just never made it easy.
case.challenge.quote_by: Fundraising & Development Team, Madrasah Darul Falah
case.solution.title: The solution
case.solution.intro: With Ihsan, the madrasah added a donation form and a floating donate button to its existing website with a single script tag — no developer needed. The Development Fund became a campaign page with a live progress bar, and monthly giving became the default ask.
case.solution.point1: Embedded donation form & floating button installed in one afternoon
case.solution.point2: Development Fund campaign page with a target & live progress
case.solution.point3: Monthly auto-debit plans donors manage themselves via the Donor Portal
case.solution.point4: Automatic, LHDN-ready PDF receipts for every donation
case.solution.point5: Virtual Terminal for walk-in and phone donations at the office
case.solution.point6: Smart retry that automatically recovers failed recurring payments
case.results.title: The results
case.results.p1: Within months, online donation conversions more than doubled compared to the old transfer-and-WhatsApp flow. 38% of online donors chose a monthly plan, giving the madrasah predictable income it could plan around for the first time.
case.results.p2: Because 92% of donors opt to cover the processing fee, almost every ringgit given reaches the students. And with receipts, reminders, and failed-payment retries fully automated, the office saves more than ten hours of manual work each month.
case.results.quote: In the first month, recurring donations alone covered our students' meal programme. Now we plan ahead instead of waiting for the next appeal.
